## Specific task description

Task instruction: Click the top center of the medium-sized bell.

Task description: The target is the medium silver bell on a black circular base at the front left of the table. Press the center of its top.

Success criteria: The left gripper is closed and actually contacts the surface near the center of the bell's top. Hovering above the bell does not count as completion.

## Execution tips

- Consider contacting the raised center feature with the fingertip of the closed left gripper so the solid contact surface covers it, rather than letting the feature fall into the gap between the fingers.
- Approach the bell from above and lower slowly in small increments near the surface. Avoid scraping across the curved bell face at an angle and missing its center.
